To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the capacity of orthogonal STBC over correlated Rayleigh or Rician fading channels can be determined from an equivalent scalar channel with a channel power gain proportional to the channel Frobenius norm, the error probability of orthogonal STBCs over correlated Rayleigh fading channels can be expressed in terms of the error probability for the scalar AWGN channel, and the capacity and probability error for multiuser DS-CDMA systems employing a STBC can be determined by considering the equivalent scalar channel with the same channel power gain
the capacity and error performance of orthogonal space-time codes are significantly degraded in correlated Rayleigh fading channels.
the error probability and the capacity of STBC over correlated Rayleigh and correlated Rician fading channels are derived.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the capacity and performance of STBCs over correlated fading channels and multiuser DS-CDMA systems.
the performance of space-time codes in correlated fading channels.
the capacity and error performance of orthogonal STBCs over correlated fading channels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the performance of the proposed system is superior to that of the existing systems.
the capacity and error performance of orthogonal STBCs is very sensitive to the correlation of the fading channel.
the capacity and error performance of orthogonal STBCs over correlated fading channels is very much dependent on the correlation coefficient and the number of transmit antennas.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the error probability of a multiuser system employing orthogonal STBC over correlated Rayleigh and Ricean fading channels can be obtained from the error probability of an equivalent scalar AWGM channel with a channel gains proportional to the Frobe-nius norm of the channel.
the performance analysis for STBCs in correlated fading channels is more complicated than in the case of uncorrelated fading.
for a fixed transmit power, the performance of the STBC over correlated Rayleigh and correlated Rician fading channels can be significantly improved over the performance of a single antenna system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the capacity and the probability of error of STBCs are not significantly affected by the correlation of the channel.
the performance of STBCs over correlated channels can be analyzed in a similar manner to the performance of STCs over uncorrelated channels.

the capacity and error performance of STBCs over correlated fading channels is significantly different from that of uncorrelated fading channels, and the performance gap between correlated and uncorrelated channels is more significant for large number of transmit antennas.
